title: Varginha witnesses in DC and FBI letter
summary: Eric Burles tells of Varginha witnesses in DC and FBI letter, about 1996; event in DC 2020s at Varginha, Brazil, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So when the after the Venia case when when those um individuals from Brazil came over, I was, you know, I was there with the with James Fox and and Leslie Leslie Keane and we were hearing from these individuals after the meeting.

plain: A US congressman named Eric Burles told Jesse Michels about the Varginha case, a 1996 UFO case from the town of Varginha in Brazil. He says that in the 2020s, people from Brazil connected to the case came to Washington, and he was there with filmmaker James Fox and journalist Leslie Keane, hearing from them after a meeting. If true, it would mean witnesses to a foreign case were being heard in the US capital.
